description: Works out the network, broadcast, host range, netmask and wildcard for an IPv4 or IPv6 address with a prefix, and can split an IPv4 network into equal smaller subnets.

address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address with a prefix or mask, such as 192.168.1.10/24, 192.168.1.10 255.255.255.0 or 2001:db8::/48.

mask.description: IPv4 only: prefix length (24 or /24) or dotted mask, when the address has none.

split.description: IPv4 only: split the network into at least this many equal subnets (rounded up to a power of two; the first 256 are listed).

name: subnet_calculator
title: Subnet calculator
